description.zh:
是否查询集群内云产品服务角色 KubeConfig 列表

- true: 查询集群内云产品服务角色 KubeConfig 列表
- false: 查询集群内RAM用户/角色 KubeConfig 列表
description.en:
Specifies whether to query the KubeConfig list of cloud service roles in the cluster. Valid values:

- true: queries the KubeConfig list of cloud service roles in the cluster.
- false: queries the KubeConfig list of Resource Access Management (RAM) users or roles in the cluster.

description.zh:
页码。

- 取值范围：大于等于1

- 默认值：1
description.en:
The page number.

- Valid values: 1 or greater.

- Default value: 1.

description.zh:
每页记录数。
- 取值范围：1-50

- 默认值：10
description.en:
The number of records per page.
- Valid values: 1 to 50.

- Default value: 10.

title.zh: 获取指定集群已颁发的KubeConfig列表
title.en: Query the list of issued kubeConfigs for a specified cluster

descriptions.zh:
> - 使用该接口需要拥有ram:ListUsers和ram:ListRoles权限
> - 使用该接口需要拥有管理容器服务（CS）的权限（AliyunCSFullAccess）
descriptions.en:
> - To call this operation, you must have the ram:ListUsers and ram:ListRoles permissions.
> - To call this operation, you must have full access to Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) (AliyunCSFullAccess).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs list-cluster-kubeconfig-states --cluster-id c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cloud-service-kube-config true --region cn-hangzhou
